body: apps/desktop Settings panel 2026-05-25 (renderer/src/SettingsPanel.tsx): modal with three sections — File formats (per-ext render toggle, gates registry via formats[ext]), JSON viewer (9 themes/depth/indent/displayDataTypes/displayObjectSize/enableClipboard, applied by routing JSONViewer directly w/ options prop in App), Keyboard shortcuts catalog (read-only, 14 chords). Persisted to lib:settings (matches chrome-ext key); deep-merged with DEFAULT_SETTINGS on hydrate for forward-compat. Opens from Settings cog icon (last in header). Also: TOC trigger icon changed from PanelRight→List to remove visual duplicate-sidebar collision with PanelLeft. Build + tsc + offscreen render verified visually. NOT built (out of scope per user): TaskPanel cross-file aggregator, per-shortcut rebind UI.
